## Requirements (contract)

1. Reconcile remaining legacy semantic/provenance repairs against actual retained
   captures and approved policy; execute only an explicitly bounded selected scope.
2. Pin jobs; record before/after inventories, resource use, and a `+0` rerun;
   rematerialize in dependency order under the shared temporal/publication contract.
3. Freeze an unpublished repaired-input snapshot + audit preview (actual source,
   schema, semantic-rules identities) — the HUMAN-H4 frame, NOT the release
   candidate; reserved batch-05 calendar verification unchanged.
4. Record provisional production rules still active vs new shadow-eligibility
   results; installing the evaluator activates nothing; any approved safety demotion
   is explicitly scoped in the live packet (none in this stage).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Dry-run and applied scope match; missing bytes never trigger undeclared
      refetch; checkpoint interruption/restart produce no duplicate repair.
- [ ] Resource plan fits approved disk/runtime; no person/plate data; every new
      fact/disposition binds evidence and authority.
- [ ] Snapshot digest + population frame frozen for HUMAN-H4; preview explicitly
      provisional; no public pointer or HG-11 decision changed; final candidate is
      P32.23a's.
- [ ] Verification green; meaningful tests for every new behavior; requirement ids
      stamped in PR; non-verifiable items have owned DEFERRALS rows + compensating
      controls; ADRs for new decisions; closeout protocol followed.

## Plan

Design decision (recorded in ADR-141): the P32.6 planner (`recovery-plan/1`) is
deliberately dry-run-only, so this ticket adds the **application half** behind the
same action-digest contract:

- **`db` sqitch change `recovery_apply`** — `recovery_application`, the append-only
  applied-receipt/marker table (`UNIQUE(action_digest)` is the exactly-once barrier,
  mirroring `intake.application`/`operation_id`), plus `sig_recovery` — a NOLOGIN
  least-privilege role with the same narrow grant shape as `sig_intake_bridge`
  (INSERT claim, UPDATE(sys_period)-only claim close, INSERT claim_evidence,
  INSERT publication_disposition + its seq, INSERT ingest_run, guarded
  curator-entity mint, validation SELECTs, `sig_read_sealed` read-scope).
- **`db/src/db/recovery_apply.py`** — `PgRecoveryApplier`: per-action one-transaction
  apply (advisory lock on the action digest → marker check → provenance re-verify →
  target write → marker INSERT). `record_disposition` → `db.dispositions.record_disposition`
  through `policy.eligibility.new_disposition`; `repair_claim` → the §16.6 pair (close
  old `sys_period`, insert the corrected claim `revises_claim` + `correction_reason` +
  adjudicator `asserted_by`, re-bind the same captures); `bind_verified_capture` →
  `INSERT claim_evidence ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` with an honest recorded outcome —
  `recovery-plan/1` bind proposals always target already-`establishes`-bound captures
  (the audit only probes establishes bindings), so the PK makes the INSERT a +0 and the
  outcome is recorded `conflict_existing` with an `untyped_binding` finding for
  HUMAN-H4, never a fabricated new row.
- **`ops/src/ops/recovery_apply.py`** — `execute_bounded_apply` (scope selection by
  batch/kind/claim, dry-run↔applied digest reconciliation, fail-closed plan checks —
  plan_version, audit-input population digest, ceilings — before/after inventories +
  resource measurements + `--verify-rerun` +0 proof), `rematerialize` (the six
  materializers in the P31.16 dependency order over the same conn/DSN, append-only +
  +0-verified), `freeze_snapshot` (`sig.repaired-snapshot/1` — frozen unpublished
  HUMAN-H4 frame), `audit preview`, `provisional-vs-shadow` report, and the
  `recovery-apply-return-pass/1` live packet.
- **CLI** — additive `sig-ops recovery-apply`, `sig-ops recovery-freeze`, and a
  deterministic `sig-ops recovery-fixture-seed` (the bounded fixture spine that both
  the DB tests and the committed artifact run share).
- **Committed artifacts** — `docs/build/reports/p32.22-bounded-recovery/`:
  fixture spine, audit report, recovery plan, APPLY_REPORT.json/md, REPAIRED_SNAPSHOT,
  AUDIT_PREVIEW, PROVISIONAL_VS_SHADOW, LIVE_RETURN_PASS, README.

## Test matrix

| AC | test |
|---|---|
| dry-run↔applied scope match | `test_scope_reconciliation` (selected ⊆ proposed; digest equality), apply report `scope` block |
| missing bytes → no refetch | `test_apply_never_fetches` — apply takes no transport/probe-write path; missing-byte actions are `no_write` and skipped; a bind action re-verifies recorded digest only |
| interruption/restart no dup | `test_restart_mid_plan_no_duplicates`, `test_failed_action_leaves_no_marker`, +0 re-apply counts |
| +0 rerun | `test_plus_zero_rerun` / `--verify-rerun` |
| resource bounds | `test_exceeds_ceiling_refuses`, batch-bound checks, recorded resource block |
| dispositions land | `test_disposition_rows_land` — real publication_disposition rows with authority/evidence |
| repair §16.6 | `test_repair_claim_pair` — old sys_period closed, new claim `revises_claim`+reason, evidence re-bound |
| bind honesty | `test_bind_conflict_recorded` — no fabricated row; `conflict_existing` + finding |
| no person/plate | Part VIII screen on revised fields + fixture carries none |
| role enforcement | `test_apply_under_sig_recovery` — full apply under `SET ROLE sig_recovery`; role can't UPDATE other columns / DELETE |
| snapshot freeze | `test_snapshot_is_frozen_unpublished` — digest stable, provisional, no release pointer |
| provisional-vs-shadow | `test_shadow_report` — policy mode shadow, `applied=()`, activation refusal |
| rematerialize order | `test_rematerialize_dependency_order` — steps run in the recorded order, +0 re-run |
| CLI | dry-run default refuses writes without `--apply`; `--apply` path on the fixture DSN |
